tools.name: Robots.txt Tester
tools.title: Free Robots.txt Tester for Your URL List | Base2026
tools.description: Robots.txt tester for your URL list. Check supplied Allow and Disallow rules, see matched paths and export results. Local processing; no website crawl.

og.title: Free Robots.txt Tester for Your URL List | Base2026
og.description: Robots.txt tester for your URL list. Check supplied Allow and Disallow rules, see matched paths and export results. Local processing; no website crawl.

tools.usecase: See the matching rule for each supplied URL before you change robots.txt. Nothing is fetched or submitted.

inputs.label: robots.txt content
inputs.help: Paste the file content or choose a UTF-8 .txt file. Maximum 64 KiB. Google-style Allow/Disallow matching; unsupported directives are reported.

inputs.label: URLs to test
inputs.help: One absolute HTTP(S) URL per line, from one origin: the same scheme, host and port. Up to 5,000 URLs. The URLs are never visited.

boundaries: Tests supplied rules only; live robots.txt, HTTP status, page meta directives and indexing remain unknown.
Allowing crawling does not guarantee indexing. A robots.txt block is not a noindex instruction.
Supports Google-style group selection, Allow/Disallow, * and terminal $. Crawl-delay, Host, Noindex and unknown directives are displayed but not applied.

tools.name: Redirect Map Checker
tools.title: Free Redirect Map Checker for CSV Plans | Base2026
tools.description: Redirect map checker for CSV plans. Find conflicting targets, loops and chains in supplied mappings. Export a review before implementation; no live HTTP requests.

og.title: Free Redirect Map Checker for CSV Plans | Base2026
og.description: Redirect map checker for CSV plans. Find conflicting targets, loops and chains in supplied mappings. Export a review before implementation; no live HTTP requests.

tools.usecase: Check the redirect plan you already have. Find conflicting mappings and follow chains without sending a request to your site.

inputs.label: Redirect mappings CSV
inputs.help: Required headers: from,to. Optional: status. Absolute HTTP(S) URLs only. Up to 5,000 mappings. Missing status stays unknown.

boundaries: This checks a supplied plan, not live redirects or response headers. Final targets are terminal entries in the map, not verified 200 pages.
URL identity is exact after surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Case, query and trailing slash are preserved.
Conflicting sources are excluded from chain resolution. You decide which mapping is correct; the tool never changes your server.

tools.name: Hreflang Map Checker
tools.title: Free Hreflang Checker for Alternate URL Maps | Base2026
tools.description: Hreflang map checker for CSV exports. Find conflicting language targets, missing self references and return links in supplied data. No page fetching.

og.title: Free Hreflang Checker for Alternate URL Maps | Base2026
og.description: Hreflang map checker for CSV exports. Find conflicting language targets, missing self references and return links in supplied data. No page fetching.

tools.usecase: Bring your alternate URL map. Review conflicting language targets, self references and return links in the data you supplied.

inputs.label: Hreflang map CSV
inputs.help: Required headers: page_url,hreflang,alternate_url. One alternate link per row. Up to 5,000 rows. Include all pages you want to compare.

boundaries: Checks the supplied map only. It does not fetch page HTML, HTTP headers, canonicals or Google indexing.
A return link can be checked only when the destination page is present in the supplied map. Missing maps and links in conflicting language slots remain unknown.
Language-tag shape is checked, not every ISO language/region assignment or Google support. Conflicting language slots are excluded from self-reference and return-link inference.

tools.name: Broken Link Task Builder
tools.title: Free Broken Link Report from Crawl Exports | Base2026
tools.description: Broken link task builder for crawl exports. Join supplied 404/410 statuses with inlinks and export source pages and repair tasks. No crawl or automatic changes.

og.title: Free Broken Link Report from Crawl Exports | Base2026
og.description: Broken link task builder for crawl exports. Join supplied 404/410 statuses with inlinks and export source pages and repair tasks. No crawl or automatic changes.

tools.usecase: Stop handing over a list of dead URLs without their source pages. Join your two exports and prepare a concrete repair list.

inputs.label: Response status CSV
inputs.help: Required headers: url,status. Optional: observed_at. Only supplied 404/410 responses become broken-link tasks.

inputs.label: Inlinks CSV
inputs.help: Required headers: source,target. Optional: anchor. A Screaming Frog-style From/To/Anchor Text export is also supported. Up to 5,000 records per file.

boundaries: A supplied 404/410 is evidence at the observation time, not a live check. A 403, 429, timeout, absent status or conflicting status is unknown; a 5xx needs review.
Source pages and anchors come only from your supplied inlinks. Link counts are counts in this export, not a complete site graph.
The output is a repair handoff. It never chooses replacements, edits links or submits changes.

tools.name: SEO Crawl Comparison
tools.title: Free SEO Crawl Comparison from CSV Exports | Base2026
tools.description: SEO crawl comparison for CSV exports. Review supplied changes to status, titles, canonicals, robots directives and headings. No crawling or ranking claims.

og.title: Free SEO Crawl Comparison from CSV Exports | Base2026
og.description: SEO crawl comparison for CSV exports. Review supplied changes to status, titles, canonicals, robots directives and headings. No crawling or ranking claims.

tools.usecase: Compare the observations before and after a site change. Keep field changes separate from missing coverage and planned changes.

inputs.label: Before crawl CSV
inputs.help: Required: url. Compare any shared columns: status,title,canonical,robots,h1,description,link_count. Standard header aliases are supported.

inputs.label: After crawl CSV
inputs.help: Use the same columns and crawler scope where possible. Up to 5,000 rows per file. Exact URL joins; no automatic mapping between different URLs.

boundaries: Reports supplied snapshot changes, not live page behavior, a ranking effect or the cause of a traffic change.
A URL found in one partial export is an observation about coverage, not proof that the page was added or deleted.
Only shared supported fields are compared. Missing columns stay unknown. Invalid or conflicting duplicate rows are excluded from comparison.

tools.name: Indexing Signal Reconciler
tools.title: Free Indexing Signal Reconciler for CSV Exports | Base2026
tools.description: Compare supplied crawl, sitemap and Search Console observations. Find contradictory signals and missing evidence locally, without fetching pages or predicting Google indexing.

og.title: Free Indexing Signal Reconciler for CSV Exports | Base2026
og.description: Compare supplied crawl, sitemap and Search Console observations. Find contradictory signals and missing evidence locally, without fetching pages or predicting Google indexing.

tools.usecase: Bring your crawl signals and optional sitemap or Search Console observations. See where the supplied evidence agrees, conflicts or leaves a question open.

inputs.label: Crawl signals CSV
inputs.help: Required: url and at least one of status,robots,canonical. HTTP status must be a numeric code from 100 to 599. Up to 5,000 rows.

inputs.label: Sitemap URLs (optional)
inputs.help: One absolute HTTP(S) URL per line, a CSV with url or loc, or an XML urlset. Up to 5,000 URLs. Omit this input to keep sitemap membership unknown.

inputs.label: Search Console observations CSV (optional)
inputs.help: Prepare these explicit columns: url, with any of gsc_status,google_canonical,last_crawl. This is a user-prepared column contract, not automatic support for every native Search Console export.

boundaries: Reports observations in supplied files only. Aligned supplied signals do not establish live indexability, Google indexing, rankings or an outcome.

Missing, invalid and conflicting observations remain distinct. Canonical targets outside the crawl or in conflicting crawl rows stay unknown. All applicable findings are exported; the primary label is only a review order.

URL joins preserve the exact trimmed string, including case, query and trailing slash. Robots none means noindex and nofollow. Unrecognized directives cannot prove an index signal. Crawler-scoped directives are preserved as text but their applicability remains unknown.
Search Console status and dates are supplied text, not API verification. No native coverage export layout is assumed. Missing sitemap or Search Console input stays unknown.

tools.name: Redirect Rule Compiler
tools.title: Free Cloudflare Static _redirects Draft from CSV | Base2026
tools.description: Turn a CSV map into a draft Cloudflare static assets _redirects file. Exclude conflicting paths, cycles and unsafe syntax. Local processing; test the draft in staging.

og.title: Free Cloudflare Static _redirects Draft from CSV | Base2026
og.description: Turn a CSV map into a draft Cloudflare static assets _redirects file. Exclude conflicting paths, cycles and unsafe syntax. Local processing; test the draft in staging.

tools.usecase: Turn your supplied map into an exact-path _redirects draft for Cloudflare static assets. Review excluded rows, then test the draft in staging before use.

inputs.label: Redirect mappings CSV
inputs.help: Required headers: from,to. Optional: status. Use exact root-relative paths or HTTP(S) source URLs from one origin. Up to 2,000 mappings. Queries in either source or target are excluded.

boundaries: Emits a draft for exact paths in Cloudflare static assets _redirects only. It does not generate Workers routing, Bulk Redirects, Apache, NGINX or Vercel configuration. Test host routing, asset and Worker precedence, incoming-query behavior and redirects in staging. No server behavior is verified here.

Queries in either source or target are excluded: this MVP does not choose query preservation or replacement behavior. Incoming request queries still require staging checks. Fragments, dot segments, protocol-relative URLs, whitespace, controls, wildcards, placeholders and ambiguous escapes are excluded.

Absolute source URLs must have one origin. Mixed origins quarantine the entire batch; no first-row origin wins. With one origin, the draft paths apply to the deployment host, which you must verify. Paths keep exact case, slash and percent-escape spelling.

Cycles, conflicting sources and paths reaching excluded mappings are withheld. Chain flattening is off by default; opting in permits only identical status codes. Terminal targets are supplied map endpoints, not verified live destinations.

Local safety caps: 2,000 input rows, 4,096 characters per URL and 1,000 characters per emitted line. ASCII paths or unambiguous percent-encoded UTF-8 only. These bounds do not establish compatibility with your deployment.
